flawless: I wander the Morass forever, and you could not even slow me down.
Join us... no? Ah, but you looked so lost already.
solid: You struck my mist, and it remembered pain... how quaint.
The marsh keeps what it takes. Today it took a little of you.
close: You almost set me free... almost... do not do that, I like it here.
So close to rest... so close... and yet I linger. Thank you, I think.
